6	import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'
7	import { Readable } from 'node:stream'
8	import type { ConnectionFetchHandler } from './rpc.ts'
9	
10	/** Default carrier cap for all HTTP RPC bodies: sized for the default
11	 * aggregate image limit (200 MiB) after base64 expansion plus envelope
12	 * headroom (~267.7 MiB required), rounded up for slack. The bridge buffers
13	 * each body in memory, so this cap is also the per-request resident bound. */
14	export const DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES = 300 * 1024 * 1024
15	
16	/**
17	 * Bridge one node:http request to the fetch-shaped handler (client close
18	 * aborts; response bodies stream out chunk by chunk).
19	 * @param req - incoming node:http request.
20	 * @param res - node:http response the bridge writes and owns to completion.
21	 * @param apiHandler - fetch-shaped API carrier the request is dispatched to.
22	 * @param maxRequestBodyBytes - maximum bytes buffered for a buffered route.
23	 */
24	export async function bridge(
25	  req: IncomingMessage,
26	  res: ServerResponse,
27	  apiHandler: ConnectionFetchHandler,
28	  maxRequestBodyBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES,
29	): Promise<void> {
30	  const abort = new AbortController()
31	  // Client-disconnect detection MUST hang off the response, not the request:
32	  // since Node 16, IncomingMessage 'close' fires as soon as the request body is
33	  // fully consumed (immediately for a bodyless GET), which would abort a
34	  // streaming response right after open. ServerResponse 'close' fires on connection teardown;
35	  // writableEnded distinguishes a normal end() from the client going away.
36	  res.on('close', () => {
37	    if (!res.writableEnded) abort.abort()
38	  })
39	  /* v8 ignore next 2 -- node:http always sets url/method on server requests. */
40	  const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://dsh.internal')
41	  const method = req.method ?? 'GET'
42	  const headers = Object.fromEntries(
43	    Object.entries(req.headers).filter(([, value]) => typeof value === 'string') as [string, string][],
44	  )
45	  const bodyMode = apiHandler.requestBodyMode({ method, url })
46	  let request: Request
47	  if (bodyMode === 'buffered') {
48	    const declaredLength = req.headers['content-length']
49	    if (declaredLength !== undefined && Number(declaredLength) > maxRequestBodyBytes) {
50	      res.writeHead(413, { connection: 'close' })
51	      res.end()
52	      req.destroy()
53	      return
54	    }
55	    const chunks: Buffer[] = []
56	    let received = 0
57	    for await (const chunk of req) {
58	      const buffer = chunk as Buffer
59	      received += buffer.byteLength
60	      if (received > maxRequestBodyBytes) {
61	        res.writeHead(413, { connection: 'close' })
62	        res.end()
63	        req.destroy()
64	        return
65	      }
66	      chunks.push(buffer)
67	    }
68	    request = new Request(url, {
69	      method,
70	      headers,
71	      ...chunks.length > 0 ? { body: Buffer.concat(chunks) } : {},
72	      signal: abort.signal,
73	    })
74	  } else {
75	    request = new Request(url, {
76	      method,
77	      headers,
78	      body: Readable.toWeb(req) as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>,
79	      signal: abort.signal,
80	      duplex: 'half',
81	    } as RequestInit & { duplex: 'half' })
82	  }
83	  const response = await apiHandler.fetch(request)
84	  const requestUnread = bodyMode === 'streaming' && !req.readableEnded
85	  const responseHeaders = Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries())
86	  res.writeHead(response.status, requestUnread ? { ...responseHeaders, connection: 'close' } : responseHeaders)
87	  if (response.body === null) {
88	    res.end()
89	    if (requestUnread) req.destroy()
90	    return
91	  }
92	  for await (const chunk of response.body) {
93	    // Backpressure: a false return means the socket buffer is full — wait for drain
94	    // instead of buffering unboundedly (slow or suspended consumers). 'close' also
95	    // resolves so a mid-wait disconnect can't park this loop forever; the close
96	    // handler above aborts the handler stream, which then ends the iteration.
97	    if (!res.write(chunk)) {
98	      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
99	        const done = (): void => {
100	          res.off('drain', done)
101	          res.off('close', done)
102	          resolve()
103	        }
104	        res.once('drain', done)
105	        res.once('close', done)
106	      })
107	    }
108	  }
109	  res.end()
110	  if (requestUnread) req.destroy()
111	}

309	function waitForReady<T>(ready: Promise<T>, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
310	  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {

314	    }, timeoutMs)
315	    const aborted = (): void => {
316	      finish({ error: new Error('connection generation aborted', { cause: signal.reason }) })

318	    const finish = (outcome: { readonly value: T } | { readonly error: Error }): void => {
319	      if (settled) return
320	      settled = true
321	      clearTimeout(timeout)
322	      signal.removeEventListener('abort', aborted)
323	      if ('error' in outcome) reject(outcome.error)
324	      else resolve(outcome.value)
325	    }
326	    signal.addEventListener('abort', aborted, { once: true })
327	    void ready.then(
328	      (value) => { finish({ value }) },
329	      (error: unknown) => {
330	        finish({ error: error as Error })
331	      },
332	    )
333	  })

209	function rpcFetchHandler(
210	  channel: string,
211	  handler: ConnectionRpcHandler,
212	): ConnectionFetchHandler {
213	  return {
214	    requestBodyMode: () => 'buffered',
215	    async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
216	      const endpoint = endpointFromPath(channel, new URL(request.url).pathname)
217	      if (request.method !== 'POST' || endpoint === undefined) {
218	        return new Response('not found', { status: 404 })
219	      }
220	
221	      const mediaType = request.headers.get('content-type')?.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase()
222	      if (mediaType !== 'application/json') {
223	        return new Response('content type must be application/json', { status: 415 })
224	      }
225	
226	      let body: unknown
227	      try {
228	        body = await request.json()
229	      } catch {
230	        return new Response('body is not JSON', { status: 400 })
231	      }
232	
233	      const envelope = clientRequestSchema.safeParse(body)
234	      if (!envelope.success) {
235	        return invalidEnvelopeResponse(body, envelope.error.issues)
236	      }
237	      const message: ClientRequest = envelope.data
238	      if (message.method !== endpoint) {
239	        return errorResponse(message.rpcId, {
240	          code: 'gateway/bad-request',
241	          message: `method ${JSON.stringify(message.method)} does not match endpoint ${JSON.stringify(endpoint)}`,
242	          details: { issues: [] },
243	        })
244	      }
245	
246	      try {
247	        const result = await handler(endpoint, message.payload, request.signal)
248	        return fullResponse(message.rpcId, result)
249	      } catch (error) {
250	        return new Response(`handler failure: ${String(error)}`, { status: 500 })
251	      }
252	    },
253	  }
254	}
255	
256	function invalidEnvelopeResponse(body: unknown, issues: readonly object[]): Response {
257	  const rawId = (body as { rpcId?: unknown } | null)?.rpcId
258	  const rpcId = typeof rawId === 'string' ? RpcId(rawId) : INVALID_REQUEST_RPC_ID
259	  return errorResponse(rpcId, {
260	    code: 'gateway/bad-request',
261	    message: 'invalid client-request message',
262	    details: { issues },
263	  })
264	}
265	
266	function endpointFromPath(channel: string, pathname: string): string | undefined {
267	  if (!pathname.startsWith(`${channel}/`)) return undefined
268	  const endpoint = pathname.slice(channel.length + 1)
269	  const segments = endpoint.split('/')
270	  if (segments.some(segment =>
271	    segment === '' || segment === '.' || segment === '..' || !ENDPOINT_SEGMENT_PATTERN.test(segment))) {
272	    return undefined
273	  }
274	  return endpoint
275	}
276	
277	function errorResponse(rpcId: RpcIdType, error: ConnectionRpcFailure): Response {
278	  return fullResponse(rpcId, { ok: false, error })
279	}
280	
281	function fullResponse(rpcId: RpcIdType, result: ConnectionRpcResult<unknown>): Response {
282	  const body: ConnectionServerResponse = { type: 'server-response', rpcId, result }
283	  return Response.json(body)
284	}
285	
286	function assertChannel(channel: string): void {
287	  if (!CHANNEL_PATTERN.test(channel) || channel === '/api') {
288	    throw new Error(`connection: invalid or reserved RPC channel ${JSON.stringify(channel)}`)
289	  }
290	}
291	
292	function assertFetchRoute(route: ConnectionFetchRoute): void {
293	  if (endpointFromPath(API_PATH, route.path) === undefined) {
294	    throw new Error(`connection: invalid exact Fetch route ${JSON.stringify(route.path)}`)
295	  }
296	  if (route.methods.length === 0) {
297	    throw new Error(`connection: exact Fetch route ${JSON.stringify(route.path)} declares no methods`)
298	  }
299	  const methods = new Set(route.methods)
300	  if (methods.size !== route.methods.length) {
301	    throw new Error(`connection: exact Fetch route ${JSON.stringify(route.path)} repeats a method`)
302	  }
303	}

#### Thinking

The current rxlab bundle mirrors the full Cordis web client (browser plugin roster) — the entire chat UI. The user wants a standalone React+shadcn app that does NOT use this Cordis client layer ("核心UI不是基于base profile开发的" - the UI isn't developed on top of the Cordis base/roster).

So architecture: rxlab profile = agent backend with host plane only (no browser client roster, or minimal), serving a standalone SPA from its own dist. The SPA talks to host over the /api RPC? But that Cordis transport is designed for the Cordis client runtime... - src/lib/theme.tsx: ThemeProvider + useTheme.
Implementation:
```tsx
import * as React from 'react'
type Theme = 'light'|'dark'
const THEME_KEY='rxlab-theme'
const ThemeContext = React.createContext<{theme: Theme; setTheme(t:Theme):void} | null>(null)
export function ThemeProvider({children, defaultTheme='light'}:{children:React.ReactNode; defaultTheme?:Theme}){
 const [theme,setThemeState]=React.useState<Theme>(()=> { const s= localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY); return s==='dark'||s==='light'?s:defaultTheme })
 React.useEffect(()=>{ document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', theme==='dark'); localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY,theme)},[theme])
 const setTheme=(t:Theme)=>setThemeState(t)
 return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{theme,setTheme}}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
}
export function useTheme(){ const v=React.useContext(ThemeContext); if(!v) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider'); return v }
```
localStorage access during render is SSR-unsafe but app is browser-only (Vite SPA) fine. But initial render before effect: state initial reads localStorage — runs in browser, ok.

```tsx
import * as React from 'react'
import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot'
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 shrink-0 [&_svg]:shrink-0 outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-primary/90',
        destructive: 'bg-destructive text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 dark:bg-destructive/60',
        outline: 'border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:border-input dark:hover:bg-input/50',
        secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-secondary/80',
        ghost: 'hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50',
        link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
      },
      size: {
        default: 'h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3',
        sm: 'h-8 rounded-md gap-1.5 px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5',
        lg: 'h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4',
        icon: 'size-9',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: 'default', size: 'default' },
  },
)
export interface ButtonProps extends React.ComponentProps<'button'>, VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> { asChild?: boolean }
function Button({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }: ButtonProps) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button'
  return <Comp data-slot="button" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))} {...props} />
}
export { Button, buttonVariants }
```

Slot works without ref (no focus management needed?) Radix Primitive asChild merges props into child; without ref prop ok. Many other files (dialog etc.) need refs for Radix primitives via React.forwardRef — but I'm writing components as thin wrappers *around* Radix primitives; the standard shadcn pattern uses forwardRef only to type component props; we can write plain functions spreading props (Radix components accept ref through props? Radix primitives are forwardRef internally; when we render <DialogPrimitive.Overlay {...props} /> the consumer ref isn't needed). Data-slot wrappers as plain functions fine. {
```json
  "content": "import * as React from 'react'\n\nexport type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'\n\nconst THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'rxlab-theme'\n\ninterface ThemeContextValue {\n  readonly theme: Theme\n  setTheme(theme: Theme): void\n}\n\nconst ThemeContext = React.createContext<ThemeContextValue | null>(null)\n\nfunction readStoredTheme(defaultTheme: Theme): Theme {\n  try {\n    const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)\n    return stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark' ? stored : defaultTheme\n  } catch {\n    return defaultTheme\n  }\n}\n\nexport function ThemeProvider({\n  children,\n  defaultTheme = 'light',\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode\n  defaultTheme?: Theme\n}) {\n  const [theme, setTheme] = React.useState<Theme>(() => readStoredTheme(defaultTheme))\n\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark')\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme)\n    } catch {\n      // Private browsing may reject writes; the in-memory theme still applies.\n    }\n  }, [theme])\n\n  const value = React.useMemo(\n    () => ({ theme, setTheme }),\n    [theme],\n  )\n\n  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>\n}\n\nexport function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {\n  const value = React.useContext(ThemeContext)\n  if (value === null) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider')\n  return value\n}\n",

}
```

3	 * paths a browser opens against a local HTTP API — DNS rebinding (Host names
4	 * the attacker's domain while the socket reaches this server) and cross-site
5	 * requests fired from a malicious page. The Host fence binds every request,
6	 * browser-looking or not: over plain HTTP a browser attaches neither Origin
7	 * nor Fetch-Metadata to reads (images and navigations — those
8	 * headers go only to trustworthy destinations), so an unmarked request may
9	 * still be a rebound browser read and Host is the one header rebinding cannot
10	 * forge. Non-browser and remote clients pass the same fence via loopback,
11	 * deployment-derived LAN IP literals, or a declared `trustedHosts` authority.
12	 * Network reachability and authentication stay out of scope: binding policy
13	 * belongs to the webserver config, and this fence is not an auth layer.
14	 */
15	
16	import { isLoopbackHostname } from './loopback-hostname.ts'
17	import type { ConnectionTrustRequest } from './rpc.ts'
18	
19	function header(headers: ConnectionTrustRequest['headers'], name: string): string | undefined {
20	  if (headers instanceof Headers) return headers.get(name) ?? undefined
21	  const value = headers[name]
22	  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined
23	}
24	
25	/** Normalized URL of a Host-header authority (hostname lowercased, default port stripped, IPv6 bracketed), or undefined when unparsable. */
26	function parseAuthority(authority: string): URL | undefined {
27	  try {
28	    // http: is a WHATWG "special scheme": parsing yields a non-empty hostname or throws.
29	    return new URL(`http://${authority}`)
30	  } catch {
31	    return undefined
32	  }
33	}
34	
35	/**
36	 * Assert one configured `trustedHosts` entry is a bare authority (`host` or
37	 * `host:port`) in canonical form: it must survive WHATWG parsing unchanged
38	 * (case aside). Anything parsing would silently rewrite is refused as a typo
39	 * that must fail the load loudly instead of being ignored until requests 403
40	 * or quietly changing the grant: URL parts beyond the authority
41	 * (`harness.internal/path`, `user@harness.internal` — which would authorize
42	 * the embedded hostname), stripped whitespace, a dangling colon or
43	 * zero-padded port (which would broaden an intended exact-port grant to every
44	 * port), and non-canonical host spellings (`0x7f.0.0.1`, percent-encoding,
45	 * unbracketed IPv6; IDN hosts are declared in punycode, the form the wire
46	 * carries).
47	 * @param entry - the configured value, verbatim.
48	 */
49	export function assertTrustedAuthority(entry: string): void {
50	  const entryUrl = parseAuthority(entry)
51	  if (entryUrl !== undefined && canonicalAuthority(entry, entryUrl) === entry.toLowerCase()) return
52	  throw new Error(`client-connection: trustedHosts entry ${JSON.stringify(entry)} is not a bare host[:port] authority`)
53	}
54	
55	/**
56	 * Canonical form of a parsed authority: `hostname` when no port was written,
57	 * else `hostname:port`. The port is judged from URL parses under both special
58	 * schemes (their default ports differ, so `:80` and `:443` still count as
59	 * explicit), never from the raw string, where WHATWG trimming would misread
60	 * shapes like `host:port ` as port-less.
61	 */
62	function canonicalAuthority(entry: string, entryUrl: URL): string {
63	  // An authority that parsed under http cannot fail under https.
64	  const port = entryUrl.port !== '' ? entryUrl.port : new URL(`https://${entry}`).port
65	  return port === '' ? entryUrl.hostname : `${entryUrl.hostname}:${port}`
66	}
67	
68	/**
69	 * Whether the request authority matches a `trustedHosts` entry. An entry with
70	 * an explicit port matches that exact authority; a port-less entry matches the
71	 * hostname on any port (the shape the CLI derives for IP-literal LAN serving,
72	 * where the bound port may be OS-assigned). Both sides compare through WHATWG
73	 * normalization, so case and a redundant `:80` never decide trust.
74	 */
75	function isTrustedAuthority(hostUrl: URL, trustedHosts: readonly string[]): boolean {
76	  return trustedHosts.some((entry) => {
77	    const entryUrl = parseAuthority(entry)
78	    if (entryUrl === undefined) return false
79	    return canonicalAuthority(entry, entryUrl) === entryUrl.hostname
80	      ? entryUrl.hostname === hostUrl.hostname
81	      : entryUrl.host === hostUrl.host
82	  })
83	}
84	
85	/**
86	 * Decide whether one /api request may reach the RPC bridge.
87	 * @param request - Node HTTP or Fetch request facts (headers).
88	 * @param trustedHosts - non-loopback authorities this deployment serves: exact `host:port`, or port-less `host` matching any port.
89	 * @returns true when the Host is ours (loopback or trusted) and any attached browser markers are same-origin.
90	 */
91	export function isTrustedApiRequest(request: ConnectionTrustRequest, trustedHosts: readonly string[]): boolean {
92	  // Host fence (DNS-rebinding defense), applied to every request: the browser
93	  // fills Host from the URL it believes it is talking to, so a rebound page
94	  // carries the attacker's domain here even though the socket lands on this
95	  // server. There is no marker shortcut — a browser read over plain HTTP
96	  // (images and navigations) arrives with neither Origin nor
97	  // Fetch-Metadata, indistinguishable from curl, and its response is readable
98	  // by the rebound page.
99	  const host = header(request.headers, 'host')
100	  if (host === undefined) return false
101	  const hostUrl = parseAuthority(host)
102	  if (hostUrl === undefined) return false
103	  if (!isLoopbackHostname(hostUrl.hostname) && !isTrustedAuthority(hostUrl, trustedHosts)) return false
104	  // Cross-site fence: modern browsers label the initiator relationship on
105	  // every fetch; an explicit cross-site marker is refused regardless of Origin.
106	  if (header(request.headers, 'sec-fetch-site') === 'cross-site') return false
107	  // Origin fence: when a browser attaches an Origin it must be exactly this
108	  // authority (compared through the same normalization as the Host). Absent
109	  // Origin is fine — the Host fence above already bound the request. The
110	  // literal "null" (sandboxed iframes, file: pages) is an opaque origin, refused.
111	  const origin = header(request.headers, 'origin')
112	  if (origin === undefined) return true
113	  try {
114	    return new URL(origin).host === hostUrl.host
115	  } catch {
116	    return false
117	  }
118	}

88	function createGzipMiddleware(config: ResolvedConfig): NodeMiddleware {
89	  // `compression` is typed for Express, but its runtime uses only the
90	  // node:http request and response members supplied here.

93	    threshold: config.compressionThresholdBytes,
94	    filter(request, response) {
95	      if (response.getHeader('content-range') !== undefined) return false
96	      const contentType = response.getHeader('content-type')
97	      if (typeof contentType === 'string' && contentType.toLowerCase().startsWith('text/event-stream')) return false

99	    },
100	  }) as unknown as NodeMiddleware
101	
102	  return (req, res, next) => {
103	    // The Web Worker tunnel has no socket and transfers identity bytes.
104	    if ((res as { socket?: unknown }).socket === undefined) {
105	      next()
106	      return
107	    }
108	    const encoding = new Negotiator(req).encoding(['gzip', 'identity'])
109	    const gzipRequest = Object.create(req) as IncomingMessage
110	    Object.defineProperty(gzipRequest, 'headers', {
111	      value: { ...req.headers, 'accept-encoding': encoding === 'gzip' ? 'gzip' : 'identity' },
112	    })
113	    middleware(gzipRequest, res, next)
114	  }
115	}

1	/**
2	 * node:http ↔ WHATWG fetch bridge for the /api transport (host side of the
3	 * web carrier; the fetch-shaped handler itself is transport-agnostic).
4	 */
5	
6	import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http'
7	import { Readable } from 'node:stream'
8	import type { ConnectionFetchHandler } from './rpc.ts'
9	
10	/** Default carrier cap for all HTTP RPC bodies: sized for the default
11	 * aggregate image limit (200 MiB) after base64 expansion plus envelope
12	 * headroom (~267.7 MiB required), rounded up for slack. The bridge buffers
13	 * each body in memory, so this cap is also the per-request resident bound. */
14	export const DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES = 300 * 1024 * 1024
15	
16	/**
17	 * Bridge one node:http request to the fetch-shaped handler (client close
18	 * aborts; response bodies stream out chunk by chunk).
19	 * @param req - incoming node:http request.
20	 * @param res - node:http response the bridge writes and owns to completion.
21	 * @param apiHandler - fetch-shaped API carrier the request is dispatched to.
22	 * @param maxRequestBodyBytes - maximum bytes buffered for a buffered route.
23	 */
24	export async function bridge(
25	  req: IncomingMessage,
26	  res: ServerResponse,
27	  apiHandler: ConnectionFetchHandler,
28	  maxRequestBodyBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES,
29	): Promise<void> {
30	  const abort = new AbortController()
31	  // Client-disconnect detection MUST hang off the response, not the request:
32	  // since Node 16, IncomingMessage 'close' fires as soon as the request body is
33	  // fully consumed (immediately for a bodyless GET), which would abort a
34	  // streaming response right after open. ServerResponse 'close' fires on connection teardown;
35	  // writableEnded distinguishes a normal end() from the client going away.
36	  res.on('close', () => {
37	    if (!res.writableEnded) abort.abort()
38	  })
39	  /* v8 ignore next 2 -- node:http always sets url/method on server requests. */
40	  const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://dsh.internal')
41	  const method = req.method ?? 'GET'
42	  const headers = Object.fromEntries(
43	    Object.entries(req.headers).filter(([, value]) => typeof value === 'string') as [string, string][],
44	  )
45	  const bodyMode = apiHandler.requestBodyMode({ method, url })
46	  let request: Request
47	  if (bodyMode === 'buffered') {
48	    const declaredLength = req.headers['content-length']
49	    if (declaredLength !== undefined && Number(declaredLength) > maxRequestBodyBytes) {
50	      res.writeHead(413, { connection: 'close' })
51	      res.end()
52	      req.destroy()
53	      return
54	    }
55	    const chunks: Buffer[] = []
56	    let received = 0
57	    for await (const chunk of req) {
58	      const buffer = chunk as Buffer
59	      received += buffer.byteLength
60	      if (received > maxRequestBodyBytes) {
61	        res.writeHead(413, { connection: 'close' })
62	        res.end()
63	        req.destroy()
64	        return
65	      }
66	      chunks.push(buffer)
67	    }
68	    request = new Request(url, {
69	      method,
70	      headers,
71	      ...chunks.length > 0 ? { body: Buffer.concat(chunks) } : {},
72	      signal: abort.signal,
73	    })
74	  } else {
75	    request = new Request(url, {
76	      method,
77	      headers,
78	      body: Readable.toWeb(req) as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>,
79	      signal: abort.signal,
80	      duplex: 'half',
81	    } as RequestInit & { duplex: 'half' })
82	  }
83	  const response = await apiHandler.fetch(request)
84	  const requestUnread = bodyMode === 'streaming' && !req.readableEnded
85	  const responseHeaders = Object.fromEntries(response.headers.entries())
86	  res.writeHead(response.status, requestUnread ? { ...responseHeaders, connection: 'close' } : responseHeaders)
87	  if (response.body === null) {
88	    res.end()
89	    if (requestUnread) req.destroy()
90	    return
91	  }
92	  for await (const chunk of response.body) {
93	    // Backpressure: a false return means the socket buffer is full — wait for drain
94	    // instead of buffering unboundedly (slow or suspended consumers). 'close' also
95	    // resolves so a mid-wait disconnect can't park this loop forever; the close
96	    // handler above aborts the handler stream, which then ends the iteration.
97	    if (!res.write(chunk)) {
98	      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
99	        const done = (): void => {
100	          res.off('drain', done)
101	          res.off('close', done)
102	          resolve()
103	        }
104	        res.once('drain', done)
105	        res.once('close', done)
106	      })
107	    }
108	  }
109	  res.end()
110	  if (requestUnread) req.destroy()
111	}

209	function rpcFetchHandler(

214	    requestBodyMode: () => 'buffered',
215	    async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
216	      const endpoint = endpointFromPath(channel, new URL(request.url).pathname)
217	      if (request.method !== 'POST' || endpoint === undefined) {
218	        return new Response('not found', { status: 404 })
219	      }
220	
221	      const mediaType = request.headers.get('content-type')?.split(';', 1)[0]?.trim().toLowerCase()
222	      if (mediaType !== 'application/json') {
223	        return new Response('content type must be application/json', { status: 415 })
224	      }
225	
226	      let body: unknown
227	      try {
228	        body = await request.json()
229	      } catch {
230	        return new Response('body is not JSON', { status: 400 })
231	      }
232	
233	      const envelope = clientRequestSchema.safeParse(body)
234	      if (!envelope.success) {
235	        return invalidEnvelopeResponse(body, envelope.error.issues)
236	      }
237	      const message: ClientRequest = envelope.data
238	      if (message.method !== endpoint) {
239	        return errorResponse(message.rpcId, {
240	          code: 'gateway/bad-request',
241	          message: `method ${JSON.stringify(message.method)} does not match endpoint ${JSON.stringify(endpoint)}`,
242	          details: { issues: [] },
243	        })
244	      }
245	
246	      try {
247	        const result = await handler(endpoint, message.payload, request.signal)
248	        return fullResponse(message.rpcId, result)

251	      }

261	    message: 'invalid client-request message',
262	    details: { issues },
263	  })
264	}

266	function endpointFromPath(channel: string, pathname: string): string | undefined {
267	  if (!pathname.startsWith(`${channel}/`)) return undefined
268	  const endpoint = pathname.slice(channel.length + 1)
269	  const segments = endpoint.split('/')
270	  if (segments.some(segment =>
271	    segment === '' || segment === '.' || segment === '..' || !ENDPOINT_SEGMENT_PATTERN.test(segment))) {
272	    return undefined
273	  }
274	  return endpoint
275	}

284	}

289	  }

296	  if (route.methods.length === 0) {

298	  }
299	  const methods = new Set(route.methods)
300	  if (methods.size !== route.methods.length) {
301	    throw new Error(`connection: exact Fetch route ${JSON.stringify(route.path)} repeats a method`)
302	  }

339	# ── the agent plane moves behind agent presets ─────────────────────────────
340	#
341	# Every row below composes what ONE agent contributes to the host registries:
342	# its tools, its prompt sections, its delegation backends. The base keeps them
343	# for the TUI, which is single-session and composes its agent process-wide; the
344	# Web surface disables them here and lets each session mount a preset instead.
345	#
346	# Disabling rather than deleting is deliberate: the base is shared, and a row
347	# absent from a surface overlay would silently reappear the day someone reorders
348	# the composition.
349	
350	# `shell-env` STAYS in the host plane: `apps/cli/src/web.ts` injects it to
351	# publish `DSH_WEB_URL`/`DSH_WEB_MODE`, and a host row that injects a service is
352	# the criterion for host-plane ownership — injection resolves before any session
353	# exists, so there is no agent to key by. Behind a preset realm those variables
354	# would never reach the model's shell at all.
355	
356	- id: tool-bash
357	  disabled: true
358	
359	- id: tool-pwsh
360	  disabled: true
361	
362	# The background-job REGISTRY stays on the host plane; only the model-facing
363	# `job_*` controls move. Its producers — `tool-bash` here, `tool-terminal` and a
364	# non-continuable `tool-subagent` elsewhere — are preset rows that resolve it
365	# with `ctx.get`, and an entry-local realm around the registry is invisible to
366	# every sibling row outside that realm, so `run_in_background` answered
367	# "background jobs unavailable" while the controls sat in the catalog. That is
368	# the `goals` criterion read from inside the preset: a Service a row outside its
369	# realm READS belongs to the plane both can see. The registry is keyed by owning
370	# agent, so one host instance serves every session exactly as before presets.
371	
372	- id: tool-jobs
373	  disabled: true
374	
375	- id: tool-fs
376	  disabled: true
377	
378	- id: tool-fs-search
379	  disabled: true
380	
381	- id: tool-str-replace-editor
382	  disabled: true
383	
384	# The `skill` REGISTRY stays in the host plane. It is host+per-scope layered
385	# (the tools-registry shape): deployment-level providers — repository plugins,
386	# a host skill-filesystem row — register into its global layer, while a preset's
387	# `skill-filesystem` registers into that preset's layer, and each agent reads the
388	# merged catalog its scope chain selects. Only the per-agent rows move behind
389	# presets: the base host `skill-filesystem` row is disabled here (presets own local
390	# discovery), and `tool-skill` is what a preset mounts to give its agent the
391	# catalog and loader at all.
392	
393	- id: skill-filesystem
394	  disabled: true
395	
396	- id: tool-skill
397	  disabled: true
398	
399	# The goal service and session driver stay on the host plane, where Gateway
400	# remotes resolve them. Presets own the human command and model-facing tool.
401	
402	- id: command-goal
403	  disabled: true
404	
405	- id: tool-goal
406	  disabled: true
407	
408	- id: plan-mode
409	  disabled: true
410	
411	# The token METER stays on the host plane; only the compaction backend that
412	# reads it moves. It owns the context-meter projection units, and that table is
413	# process-wide, so preset ownership would make the meter a function of which
414	# presets happen to be mounted rather than a per-session fact. Same criterion as
415	# `tasks` and `goals`; the reasoning has one home in
416	# `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-10-host-plane-ownership-after-presets.md`.
417	
418	- id: compaction-basic
419	  disabled: true
420	
421	- id: command-compact
422	  disabled: true
423	
424	- id: tool-result-pruner
425	  disabled: true
426	
427	# The subagent registry and its backends STAY in the host plane. `subagents` is
428	# a process singleton with a cross-session query surface (`listChildren`,
429	# `followup`) that the host api-proxy serves to the browser, and a provider
430	# registers under a globally unique name, so a per-session copy would both
431	# starve that host row and collide on the second session. What a preset
432	# chooses is which delegation TOOLS its agent sees, below.
433	
434	- id: tool-subagent-control
435	  disabled: true
436	
437	- id: tool-subagent-list-agents
438	  disabled: true
439	
440	- id: tool-subagent
441	  disabled: true
442	
443	- id: tool-subagent-fork
444	  disabled: true
445

447	  disabled: true
448

451

453	  disabled: true
454

462	  disabled: true

464	# The preset roster. The shipped presets are bundled inside
465	# `dsh-agent-presets` itself and prepended as a read-only `system` root

5	
6	## Context（背景与目标）
7	
8	用户需要为 deepseek-harness 增加一个全新 agent 产品 **rxlab**：`dsh rxlab` 与 `dsh web` 是两个可同时运行、互不干扰的 Web 客户端。rxlab 的**后端能力与 web profile 一致**（会话/聊天/设置/模型选择等），但 UI 需要**全新独立编排**——UI 形态参照用户预想项目 `E:\zjssos\glasses-packing-workbench`（配镜工作台）：以 deepseek-harness 为 agent 底座做 Node 集成，UI 同时承载 **agent 能力区（会话）** 与 **整配镜各业务模块的工作区**（采集 / 商品 Wiki / 验光配镜 / 推荐校验 / 效果图 / 流程结果等）。该预想仓库目前是"契约清晰、CLI/JSON 驱动"的独立模块 + 简单 HTML 结果页，其 `docs/architecture.md`「harness 化」小节明确了后续形态：模块→工具、流程 schema 复用、JobState 作状态、产物路径作上下文——即由 harness agent 编排这些模块。本 deepseek-harness 侧的任务就是先把承载这一切的 **rxlab profile + 模块化工作台 UI 框架**搭起来。

10	本阶段交付：**工作台 UI 框架 + 1~2 个占位业务模块工作区**（命名对齐配镜工作台的模块域，如"会话(Agent)"为真实可用、其余如"商品 Wiki / 配镜流程"为占位）；真实业务模块后续由用户在 deepseek-harness 侧包成工具/行，或在 glasses-packing-workbench 侧按"harness 化"小节接入。会话/设置数据与 web profile **隔离**。

16	- 在 deepseek-harness 仓库开新分支实现；glasses-packing-workbench 仅作为 UI 形态与模块划分的参照，不改动它。

18	## 架构机制（探索结论，实现依据）
19	
20	- **Profile**：`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts` `PROFILE_TEMPLATES`（web = `['@deepseek-ai/dsh-base','@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app']`）。`dsh web` 是 `apps/cli/src/args.ts` 的 Commander 硬编码别名（`resolveBoot(web,'web',…)`）。
21	- **Bundle**：`packages/bundle/<name>/` = `cordis.patch.yml`（patch 行）+ glue 插件 `src/` + `package.json`（`dsh.bundle.patch`、依赖每个被引用插件）。被引用 bundle 必须挂在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（`apps/cli/package.json`）dependencies 下，才能从安装锚点解析。
22	- **Web bundle 组装**（`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`）：base 行重述（persona、tools、sqlite 等）+ 宿主行（webserver/web-runtime/startup/controller/…）+ **浏览器 roster**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-*` 等 insert 行）。glue `src/index.ts` 解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` dist、挂 frontend-static、打印 URL、开浏览器。端口默认在 webserver 行 `port: !!js ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080`。
23	- **客户端**：无 URL 路由。`apps/web`（vite）只编译通用 shell（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web` 内核 + primitives）；真正 UI 由 profile 的 cordis 树经 `window.__DSH_BOOT__` roster 决定。渲染器只 `renderSlot('root')`；`ui-layout` 浏览器插件（`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/index.ts`）占用 root 并声明 children 席位 `sidebar/conversation/details/shell.overlay`；occupants（ui-sidebar→sidebar、ui-conversation→conversation/details、…）各自 `ctx.slots.register`。Slot 语义见 `packages/client/ui-slots`（single/list/keyed/chain；scope root/session-maybe/session）。
24	- **客户端包形态**（以 `packages/client/ui-jobs` 为模板）：双导出 `"."`（host，可空）+ `"./client"`（浏览器 bundle `lib/client.js`，tsdown 用包内 `tsdown.config.ts` + `packages/client/tsdown.client.ts` 预设），`dsh.client` manifest（`inject` 其它客户端包、`platform:'web'`），bundles 通过 `scripts/build.ts` client pass 产出。
25	- **存储默认**：`session-persistence-jsonl` 行 `root: !!js dshHomePath('sessions')`（base bundle）；settings-file 行默认 `<home>/settings.yaml`（schema 有 `path` 字段，可覆盖）；凭据 env/.credentials 共享。
26	- **测试样板**：`packages/bundle/web-app/tests/*.spec.ts`（dist/startup/trusted-hosts/browser-open）、`apps/cli/tests/args.spec.ts`、`apps/cli/tests/web-agent-presets.e2e.ts`、`apps/cli/tests/profiles/headless/tests/keyless-smoke.e2e.ts`。
27	
28	## 改动方案
29	
30	### 1. 新 bundle：`packages/bundle/rxlab-app/`（后端组装）
31	
32	以 `packages/bundle/web-app` 为模板复制改造（符合用户"复制一套组装"意图；web profile 不受影响）：
33	
34	- `cordis.patch.yml`：复制 web-app patch 全部行，改动点：
35	  - `system-prompt` persona 换成 rxlab 文案（"配镜工作台 agent 底座"身份，说明可编排采集/Wiki/验光/推荐等模块，为后续 harness 化预留；文案先收敛、不引入未实现能力）。
36	  - `webserver` 行默认端口 `?? 3081`（避免与 web 的 3080 冲突，仍可用 `--port`/`--host`）。
37	  - **数据隔离行**（web-app 没有，需新增/覆盖）：`settings` 行 `config.path: !!js dshHomePath('settings-rxlab.yaml')`；`session-persistence-jsonl` 行 `config.root: !!js dshHomePath('sessions-rxlab')`；`session-query-sqlite` 保持 web 的 `:memory:`；`attachment-local`、spill、projection 等如默认落在共享 home 路径，实现时逐一核对并指向 rxlab 专属子目录（至少所有持久化会话数据的行必须隔离）。
38	  - 浏览器 roster：**删除 `ui-layout` 行**，替换为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-rxlab-shell`；追加占位模块行（如 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-rxlab-module-demo`）。其余 roster 行（ui-session/conversation/chat/settings/sidebar/…）保留。
39	- `src/index.ts` + `src/startup.ts`：复制 web-app glue/startup，重命名插件/服务（`rxlab-app`/`rxlabStartup`），复用同一 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend` dist 解析；URL 行文案带 rxlab 标识。
40	- `package.json`：name `@deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-app`，`dsh.bundle.patch`；dependencies 复制 web-app 全部，并把两个新客户端包加入。
41	- `README.md/.zh.md`、`tests/*`（镜像 web-app 的 dist/startup/flags 单测，先做最小集）。
42	- 在 `apps/cli/package.json` dependencies 增加 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-app`。
43	
44	### 2. CLI 入口与 profile 注册
45	
46	- `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`：`PROFILE_TEMPLATES` 增加 `rxlab: { bundles: ['@deepseek-ai/dsh-base','@deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-app'], patchReload: 'live' }`。
47	- `apps/cli/src/args.ts`：仿 `web` 增加 `rxlab` Commander 子命令别名（拒绝父级 flags 的 `rejectParentOptions`、`--patch`/dump 选项一致），并更新 HELP_EXAMPLES。
48	- 如需差异默认端口提示：见 bundle startup `--help` 文案即可（非必改）。
49	
50	### 3. 客户端：工作台式 shell + 模块框架（浏览器插件包，均在 `packages/client/`）
51	
52	UI 形态按配镜工作台预想实现：同一窗口内，左侧是**模块 rail**（会话 Agent / 商品 Wiki / 配镜流程 …），主区随激活模块切换；**会话模块承载 agent 能力**（与 web 功能一致），业务模块工作区先给占位面板，后续把 glasses-packing-workbench 模块包成 harness 工具/行后逐模块接入。新增两个包（以 `ui-jobs` 包结构为模板：`src/index.ts`(host，可仅透传)、`src/client/*`、`package.json` 双导出 + `dsh.client`、`tsdown.config.ts`、`tsconfig.json`、README 双语、`tests/`）：
53	
54	1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-rxlab-shell`
55	   - 浏览器 `apply()`：提供 `ctx.layout`/theme/locale/store 接线（照抄 ui-layout 的服务接线，保证 ui-sidebar/ui-workspace/ui-conversation 等 occupants 依赖不缺失）；`ctx.slots.register` 占用 **`root`**，children 声明与 ui-layout 一致的四席位 **加上** 模块席位：
56	     - `na.rail`（list, root）：模块导航条目（模块贡献 key/label/icon，参照配镜工作台模块域：agent 会话、商品 Wiki、验光配镜、推荐校验、效果图、流程/结果）。
57	     - `na.module`（keyed, root）：模块工作台内容，按 active key 渲染（参照现有 keyed 用法：`conversation.chat.commandview`、`settings.plugin.item`）。
58	   - 新 frame 组件（工作台视觉：品牌 + 左侧模块 rail + 主区；**agent 会话模块**激活时主区渲染会话三栏席位，业务模块激活时渲染其工作台面板）。关键做法：children 席位 **与 ui-layout 使用完全相同的 key/kind/scope**（如 `conversation` single/session-maybe、`sidebar` single/root、`details` single/session、`shell.overlay` list/root），并在需要处 type-only import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/client` 的 OwnerShare 类型以维持 SlotMap 合并一致；**不**在运行时挂 ui-layout 包（root 单槽只能有一个占用者）。
59	   - "会话"模块即复用现有 occupants（ui-sidebar/ui-conversation/…）渲染，保证功能一致；"商品 Wiki / 配镜流程"等模块点击后在主区渲染 keyed 工作台面板。
60	   - SlotMap type-merge：本包只新增自有 key（`na.rail`/`na.module`），不重复声明 ui-layout 已声明的 key 成员（其类型通过 type-only import 引入）。
61	   - 注意：若与 web roster 差异导致 ui-sidebar 依赖的 `ctx.layout` 行为缺失，以 ui-layout 的服务接线为准补齐；这是本方案风险点之一（见 Risks）。
62	2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-rxlab-module-demo`（工作台模块接入示例）
63	   - 演示"如何新增一个业务模块工作区"：向 `na.rail` 注册条目 + 向 `na.module` 注册一个 keyed 工作台面板（按配镜模块域提供 1~2 个占位工作区，如"商品 Wiki"占位展示产物目录/搜索框占位、"配镜流程"占位展示步骤状态条占位；含 keyProps 与 locale）。后续真实模块 = 一个/一组浏览器插件行 + 相应 host 工具行，注册进同一席位即接入工作台。
64	
65	（如实现中发现"复用现有 conversation occupants 同时保留独立 shell"在席位类型上不可行，退路见 Risks R2。）
66

70	- `apps/cli/README.md/.zh.md`（如 dsh 文档列命令则补 `dsh rxlab`）、`apps/cli/composition.md` 由 `pnpm run gen-doc-graphs` 重新生成。

72	- `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-04-rxlab-profile-and-module-ui.md`：记录 profile/bundle/模块 UI 组装决策（非平凡改动必须有 Agent Note）。
73	
74	### 5. 测试
75	
76	- `apps/cli/tests/args.spec.ts`：新增 `dsh rxlab` 别名解析/错误分支用例。
77	- `packages/bundle/rxlab-app/tests/`：dist 解析 + startup flags + 隔离路径断言的最小单测（镜像 web-app）。
78	- 关键路径 e2e：参考 `keyless-smoke.e2e.ts`/`web-agent-presets.e2e.ts` 增加一条 rxlab profile 冒烟（replay/mock 模型下能起 profile 并得到 UI 托管 URL 类输出），作为快照策略的基线；若新增 model-visible persona 需按 snapshot ownership 规则决定是否补 recorded-session fixture（先在计划内标记为待定项，实施时按 docs/testing.md 判定）。
79	
80	## 实施顺序（checkpoint）
81	
82	1. **分支**：`git checkout -b feat/rxlab-profile`（从 master）。
83	2. 后端 bundle + PROFILE_TEMPLATES + args alias + apps/cli dep → 验证：`pnpm dsh --profile rxlab --dump-default-config` 能打印 rxlab 树；`pnpm dsh rxlab --help` 生效（无需 build 全量，typecheck 相关包）。
84	3. 隔离路径 override → 验证：跑起后 `$DSH_HOME/sessions-rxlab`、`settings-rxlab.yaml` 生效且 web 的 sessions 不被写入。
85	4. 客户端两个新包 + rxlab-app roster 更新 → `pnpm run build:lib:client` / `pnpm run build:web` 产出。
86	5. `pnpm dsh rxlab` 与 `pnpm dsh web`（不同端口）并行验证两个客户端；rxlab 工作台界面可聊、可新开会话、可进设置、模块 rail 可在"会话 / 商品 Wiki(占位) / 配镜流程(占位)"间切换并渲染对应工作台。
87	6. 测试/文档/Agent Note → 跑相关 gate：`pnpm run typecheck`、目标 vitest（args/bundle/client specs）、`verify-cordis-config`、`gen-*-catalog --check`、`doc-sync`（按需裁剪）。
88	
89	## 验证方式（最终验收）
90	
91	- `pnpm dsh rxlab`（前台）出现 `dsh rxlab:` URL（端口 3081 或 `--port` 指定）；`pnpm dsh web`（3080）同时可用，互不干扰。
92	- rxlab 浏览器界面为工作台式：模块 rail 含"会话(Agent)"与 1~2 个配镜域占位模块；会话模块可完成一次真实聊天（有 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）、会话持久化到 rxlab 专属目录；占位模块可切换展示对应工作台面板；设置/模型选择可用。
93	- `pnpm run typecheck` 通过；目标单测/e2e 通过；`--dump-default-config` 与生成目录 gate 通过。
94	
95	## Risks / 开放问题
96	
97	- **R1 端口**：rxlab 默认 3081；若 3081 也被占，提示用 `--port`（与 web 行为一致）。
98	- **R2 席位复用**：最不确定点是"rxlab-shell 声明与 ui-layout 相同的 children 席位供现有 occupants 使用"。若类型/运行时冲突不可行，退路：shell 先自带一个简化会话面（仅 ui-conversation 的会话体 + composer 核心席位），设置/模型页改为模块 stub；并在此 PR 中与用户确认取舍。
99	- **R3 代码重复**：rxlab-shell 会复制/改写 ui-layout 的 frame 逻辑；jscpd duplication gate 可能告警。缓解：优先以"适配 + 精简"而非全文复制；告警则把共享 frame 抽到中性包并让 ui-layout 与 rxlab-shell 共用（需跑 web 相关 golden 防回归）。
100	- **R4 占位模块→真实模块**：本 PR 只固化工作台 UI 接入点（`na.rail`/`na.module`）与注册示范；真实配镜模块后续按 glasses-packing-workbench「harness 化」小节接入（模块→host 工具行 + 浏览器工作台行）。

93	  // lazy grammars must not land here)
94	  'shiki',
95	  // markdown parse pipeline (micromark/mdast; the incremental React renderer
96	  // over it is workspace code)
97	  'mdast-util-from-markdown',
98	  'mdast-util-gfm',
99	  'mdast-util-math',

111	/**
112	 * Boot grammars statically imported by ui-primitives' highlight.ts
113	 * (`@shikijs/langs/typescript` → `dist/typescript.mjs`, etc.). They live in
114	 * the same package as the lazy read-card grammars, but unlike those they are
115	 * part of the initial load and belong in the vendor chunk; the lazy ones must
116	 * stay unassigned so each keeps its own on-demand chunk.
117	 */
118	const BOOT_GRAMMAR_FILES: readonly string[] = [
119	  'dist/typescript.mjs',
120	  'dist/shellscript.mjs',
121	  'dist/json.mjs',
122	]
123	
124	/** Font asset extensions routed to assets/fonts/ (KaTeX's woff2/woff/ttf faces). */
125	const FONT_EXTENSIONS: readonly string[] = ['.woff2', '.woff', '.ttf']
126	
127	/**
128	 * npm package name of a resolved module id: the segment after the last
129	 * `node_modules/`. pnpm nests the real package under an inner node_modules.
130	 */
131	function npmPackageOf(id: string): string | undefined {
132	  const parts = id.split('/node_modules/')
133	  if (parts.length === 1) return undefined
134	  const [first, second] = parts[parts.length - 1].split('/')
135	  if (first.startsWith('.')) return undefined // .pnpm store segment, not a package
136	  if (first.startsWith('@')) return second === undefined ? undefined : `${first}/${second}`
137	  return first
138	}
139	
140	export default defineConfig({
141	  // Relative asset URLs: preview.html mounts the same output under any base
142	  // directory, and the served index resolves identically from the site root.
143	  base: './',
144	  plugins: [rejectStandaloneServe(), clientDocumentTitle(), react(), emitPreviewPage()],
145	  build: {
146	    // The worker bootstrap holds its page at top-level await; Vite's default
147	    // `modules` target (es2020-era) rejects that syntax.
148	    target: 'es2022',
149	    sourcemap: true,
150	    rollupOptions: {
151	      input: {
152	        index: src('./index.html'),
153	        // Standalone entry, not an index.html script tag: Vite folds every
154	        // module tag of one page into a single synthetic entry, and only a
155	        // separate input keeps the shared page chunks bootstrap-free.
156	        bootstrap: src('./src/preview.ts'),
157	      },
158	      output: {
159	        // The worker-preview surface groups under dist/preview/ (the page
160	        // itself stays at dist/preview.html), so the published payload can
161	        // exclude it as one directory.
162	        entryFileNames(chunk): string {
163	          return chunk.name === 'bootstrap' ? 'preview/[name]-[hash].js' : 'assets/[name]-[hash].js'
164	        },
165	        // Output layout: the two main chunks stay at assets/ root; lazy
166	        // @shikijs/langs grammar chunks group under assets/langs/; fonts
167	        // (all KaTeX faces referenced by vendor.css) group under
168	        // assets/fonts/. Sourcemaps need no arrangement: rollup writes each
169	        // .map next to its js and references it by bare relative filename.
170	        chunkFileNames(chunk): string {
171	          // Grammar chunks are recognized by their member modules, not the
172	          // facade: shared embedded-grammar chunks (e.g. html+javascript,
173	          // split out because php/ruby/mdx embed them) have no facade at all.
174	          // index and vendor are excluded by name — vendor legitimately
175	          // carries the three boot grammars.
176	          if (chunk.name === 'index' || chunk.name === 'vendor') return 'assets/[name]-[hash].js'
177	          const isLangChunk = chunk.moduleIds.some(id => id.includes('/node_modules/@shikijs/langs/'))
178	          return isLangChunk ? 'assets/langs/[name]-[hash].js' : 'assets/[name]-[hash].js'
179	        },
180	        assetFileNames(asset): string {
181	          const fileName = asset.names[0] ?? ''
182	          const isFont = FONT_EXTENSIONS.some(ext => fileName.endsWith(ext))
183	          return isFont ? 'assets/fonts/[name]-[hash][extname]' : 'assets/[name]-[hash][extname]'
184	        },
185	        manualChunks(id: string): string | undefined {
186	          const pkg = npmPackageOf(id)
187	          if (pkg === undefined) return undefined // workspace + vendored cordis: index
188	          if (pkg === '@shikijs/langs') {
189	            return BOOT_GRAMMAR_FILES.some(file => id.endsWith(`/${file}`)) ? 'vendor' : undefined
190	          }
191	          return VENDOR_PACKAGES.has(pkg) ? 'vendor' : undefined
192	        },
193	      },
194	    },
195	  },
196	  worker: {
197	    // The preview worker rides dist/preview/ with the rest of that surface.
198	    rollupOptions: { output: { entryFileNames: 'preview/[name]-[hash].js' } },
199	  },
200	  resolve: {
201	    // One instance per shared npm identity: a bare specifier otherwise resolves
202	    // from the importer's directory, so a diverging range ships a second React
203	    // and splits hook and element identity. Entries are package ids — they cover
204	    // react/jsx-runtime and react-dom/client — and resolve from this package's
205	    // node_modules, so react must stay a devDependency here and any watcher must
206	    // run vite from this directory (scripts/dev-web.ts). Workspace packages need
207	    // no entry: pnpm links each of them to a single directory.
208	    dedupe: ['react', 'react-dom'],
209	    // Workspace packages are consumed as built lib products: each resolves
210	    // through its own package.json exports from the importer's directory, and
211	    // CSS still rides Vite's pipeline because the client build preset emits it
212	    // beside the bundle. Plugin packages never enter this graph; they arrive as
213	    // runtime bundles through the client module system. The remaining alias
214	    // browserizes the vendored Cordis Loader's only Node import.
215	    alias: [
216	      { find: /^node:module$/, replacement: src('./src/node-module-stub.ts') },
217	    ],
218	  },
219	  define: {
220	    ...clientBuildEnvironmentDefines(process.env),
221	    // vendored loader internal.ts: fromInternal() probes the Node major —
222	    // "0.0.0" takes neither branch, returning undefined (exactly the empty
223	    // internal slot the shell boot fills with the client module loader).
224	    'process.versions.node': '"0.0.0"',
225	    'process.execArgv': '[]',
226	    // vendored loader index.ts: envData falls to its default branch.
227	    'process.env.CORDIS_SHARED': 'undefined',
228	  },
229	})

```json
  "content": "import * as React from 'react'\n\nexport type Theme = 'light' | 'dark'\n\nconst THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'rxlab-theme'\n\ninterface ThemeContextValue {\n  readonly theme: Theme\n  setTheme(theme: Theme): void\n}\n\nconst ThemeContext = React.createContext<ThemeContextValue | null>(null)\n\nfunction readStoredTheme(defaultTheme: Theme): Theme {\n  try {\n    const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)\n    return stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark' ? stored : defaultTheme\n  } catch {\n    return defaultTheme\n  }\n}\n\nexport function ThemeProvider({\n  children,\n  defaultTheme = 'light',\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode\n  defaultTheme?: Theme\n}) {\n  const [theme, setTheme] = React.useState<Theme>(() => readStoredTheme(defaultTheme))\n\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark')\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme)\n    } catch {\n      // Private browsing may reject writes; the in-memory theme still applies.\n    }\n  }, [theme])\n\n  const value = React.useMemo(\n    () => ({ theme, setTheme }),\n    [theme],\n  )\n\n  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>\n}\n\nexport function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {\n  const value = React.useContext(ThemeContext)\n  if (value === null) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider')\n  return value\n}\n",
```

**做了什么**
- 按官方 CLI 流程：`shadcn init` 参数适配新版（`-b radix`），随后 `npx shadcn@latest add dashboard-01 -y -o` —— 官方自动覆盖了 9 个我之前手写的 ui 组件、新增 20+ 官方组件、15 个依赖（`radix-ui`/`cn`/`recharts` 等新版统一包）和 16 个 CSS 变量。今后不再手写组件副本。
- 按你选的"只要壳"组装：`AppSidebar`（官方 Sidebar，品牌头 + registry 驱动的 7 个模块导航）、`SiteHeader`（SidebarTrigger + 当前模块标题 + 主题切换）、`WorkbenchLayout`（SidebarProvider + SidebarInset），路由并入，删掉了手写的旧 AppShell。
- dashboard-01 的样例展示件（section-cards / chart / data-table / nav-* 等）保留在 `components/` 未接入，后续做模块概览时可直接当模板。

**验证**
- `tsc --noEmit`、`vite build` 均通过。
- 浏览器实测：侧栏 256px 全高、7 模块点击切换正确、header 标题跟随、深色主题切换 + localStorage 生效；控制台无报错。

function SidebarMenuButton({
  asChild = false,
  isActive = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  tooltip,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  isActive?: boolean
  tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
} & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"
  const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

  const button = (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
      data-sidebar="menu-button"
      data-size={size}
      data-active={isActive}
      className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )

  if (!tooltip) {
    return button
  }

  if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
    tooltip = {
      children: tooltip,
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent
        side="right"
        align="center"
        hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
        {...tooltip}
      />
    </Tooltip>
  )
}

function SidebarMenuAction({
  className,
  asChild = false,
  showOnHover = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  showOnHover?: boolean
}) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-action"
      data-sidebar="menu-action"
      className={cn(
        "absolute top-1.5 right-1 flex aspect-square w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-0 text-sidebar-foreground ring-sidebar-ring outline-hidden transition-transform peer-hover/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
        // Increases the hit area of the button on mobile.
        "after:absolute after:-inset-2 md:after:hidden",
        "peer-data-[size=sm]/menu-button:top-1",
        "peer-data-[size=default]/menu-button:top-1.5",
        "peer-data-[size=lg]/menu-button:top-2.5",
        "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden",
        showOnHover &&
          "group-focus-within/menu-item:opacity-100 group-hover/menu-item:opacity-100 peer-data-[active=true]/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:opacity-100 md:opacity-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

        "peer-hover/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground peer-data-[active=true]/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        "peer-data-[size=sm]/menu-button:top-1",
        "peer-data-[size=default]/menu-button:top-1.5",
        "peer-data-[size=lg]/menu-button:top-2.5",
        "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden",

function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean

}) {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()

      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState)
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState)
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  )

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
    () => ({
      state,

dashboard-01 官方壳接入完成并验证。

**做了什么**
- 按官方 CLI 流程：`shadcn init` 参数适配新版（`-b radix`），随后 `npx shadcn@latest add dashboard-01 -y -o` —— 官方自动覆盖了 9 个我之前手写的 ui 组件、新增 20+ 官方组件、15 个依赖（`radix-ui`/`cn`/`recharts` 等新版统一包）和 16 个 CSS 变量。今后不再手写组件副本。
- 按你选的"只要壳"组装：`AppSidebar`（官方 Sidebar，品牌头 + registry 驱动的 7 个模块导航）、`SiteHeader`（SidebarTrigger + 当前模块标题 + 主题切换）、`WorkbenchLayout`（SidebarProvider + SidebarInset），路由并入，删掉了手写的旧 AppShell。
- dashboard-01 的样例展示件（section-cards / chart / data-table / nav-* 等）保留在 `components/` 未接入，后续做模块概览时可直接当模板。

**验证**
- `tsc --noEmit`、`vite build` 均通过。
- 浏览器实测：侧栏 256px 全高、7 模块点击切换正确、header 标题跟随、深色主题切换 + localStorage 生效；控制台无报错。

**两点提醒**
- 依赖目前分两处：CLI 把新依赖写入 `dependencies`，而我先前的基础依赖在 `devDependencies`（还有旧 `@radix-ui/react-*` 与新版 `radix-ui` 并存）——提交前可以归并去重。
- 本地出现了一个基线提交 `e9e46487 feat(cli): 添加 rxlab 配置文件支持`（非本会话创建的），把 stage-1 + rxlab-web 初版（含 `dist/`）都提交了；仓库惯例是忽略 `apps/*/dist`（`apps/web/dist` 在 .gitignore），rxlab-web 的 dist 需要补一条 ignore + `git rm --cached` 清理。

function SidebarMenuButton({
  asChild = false,
  isActive = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  tooltip,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  isActive?: boolean
  tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
} & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"
  const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

  const button = (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
      data-sidebar="menu-button"
      data-size={size}
      data-active={isActive}
      className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )

  if (!tooltip) {
    return button
  }

  if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
    tooltip = {
      children: tooltip,
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent
        side="right"
        align="center"
        hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
        {...tooltip}
      />
    </Tooltip>
  )
}

function SidebarMenuAction({
  className,
  asChild = false,
  showOnHover = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  showOnHover?: boolean
}) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-action"
      data-sidebar="menu-action"
      className={cn(
        "absolute top-1.5 right-1 flex aspect-square w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-0 text-sidebar-foreground ring-sidebar-ring outline-hidden transition-transform peer-hover/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",
        // Increases the hit area of the button on mobile.
        "after:absolute after:-inset-2 md:after:hidden",
        "peer-data-[size=sm]/menu-button:top-1",
        "peer-data-[size=default]/menu-button:top-1.5",
        "peer-data-[size=lg]/menu-button:top-2.5",
        "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:hidden",
        showOnHover &&
          "group-focus-within/menu-item:opacity-100 group-hover/menu-item:opacity-100 peer-data-[active=true]/menu-button:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:opacity-100 md:opacity-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  const open = openProp ?? _open
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState)
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState)
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  )

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
}

134	export function resolveLanTrust(bindHost: string, extra: readonly string[]): RxlabRuntimeValues {
135	  const lanAddresses = bindHost === ALL_INTERFACES_HOST
136	    ? Object.values(networkInterfaces()).flat()
137	      .filter((iface): iface is NonNullable<typeof iface> => iface !== undefined && iface.family === 'IPv4' && !iface.internal)
138	      .map(iface => iface.address)
139	    : []
140	  return { lanAddresses, trustedHosts: [...lanAddresses, ...extra] }
141	}

194	async function openBrowser(url: string): Promise<void> {
195	  const launcher = spawnBrowserLauncher(url)
196	  let launcherStderr = ''
197	  launcher.stderr?.setEncoding('utf8')
198	  launcher.stderr?.on('data', (chunk: string) => { launcherStderr += chunk })
199	  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
200	    function onError(error: Error): void {
201	      launcher.off('close', onClose)
202	      reject(error)
203	    }
204	    function onClose(code: number | null): void {
205	      launcher.off('error', onError)
206	      if (code !== 0) {
207	        const firstLine = launcherStderr.trim().split(/\r?\n/u)[0]

209	          ? `browser launcher exited with code ${String(code)}`
210	          : firstLine.replace(/^(?:[A-Za-z]*Error):\s*/u, '')
211	        reject(new Error(reason))
212	        return
213	      }
214	      if (launcherStderr !== '') process.stderr.write(launcherStderr)
215	      resolve()
216	    }
217	    launcher.once('error', onError)
218	    launcher.once('close', onClose)
219	  })

228	/**
229	 * Mount the rxlab runtime: dist serving, surface prompt, the bash runtime
230	 * variable, the URL line, and the default-browser handoff.
231	 * @param ctx - plugin context carrying the webServer service.
232	 * @param config - validated {@link Config}.
233	 */
234	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
235	  const runtime = resolveLanTrust(ctx.webServer.host, config.trustedHosts)
236	  // The loopback URL belongs to this host. Under SSH, the operator reaches it
237	  // through a local forwarding address that this process cannot derive.
238	  const handoffBrowser = config.openBrowser && !launchedThroughSsh(ctx)
239	  // Release dependent rows only after bind-dependent trust has been sampled once.
240	  ctx.provide(RUNTIME_SERVICE, runtime)
241	  ctx.plugin(FrontendStatic, { distIndex: internals.resolveDistIndex() })
242	  if (config.surfaceContext) {
243	    ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], (promptCtx) => {
244	      addHarnessSourceSection(promptCtx, SOURCE_ROOT)
245	      promptCtx.systemPrompt.section({
246	        name: 'app:rxlab-surface',
247	        order: promptCtx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('WEB_SURFACE'),
248	        text: () => rxlabSurfacePrompt(localRxlabUrl(promptCtx)),
249	      })
250	    })
251	    ctx.inject(['shellEnv'], (runtimeCtx) => {
252	      runtimeCtx.shellEnv.register({
253	        name: 'rxlab-runtime',
254	        variables: {
255	          [DSH_RXLAB_URL]: { description: 'Canonical local URL of the DeepSeek Harness rxlab GUI serving this session.' },
256	        },
257	        resolve: () => ({ [DSH_RXLAB_URL]: localRxlabUrl(runtimeCtx) }),
258	      })
259	    })
260	  }
261	  if (config.printUrl || handoffBrowser) {
262	    ctx.inject(['connection'], (connectionCtx) => {
263	      // The URL line and browser handoff are readiness signals: supervisors RPC
264	      // as soon as they observe the line, while a browser requests the page as
265	      // soon as it opens. Neither may run while sibling rows such as the /api
266	      // route owner are still mounting. Await Loader settlement first; a
267	      // hand-built tree without a Loader is already the complete tree.
268	      const announceReady = (): void => {
269	        if (ANNOUNCED_ROOTS.has(connectionCtx.root)) return
270	        const webUrl = localRxlabUrl(connectionCtx)
271	        const authenticatedUrl = connectionCtx.connection.authenticatedUrl(webUrl)
272	        // Reuse the exact LAN snapshot provided to the /api trust fence.
273	        const lanCandidate = runtime.lanAddresses[0]
274	        const port = connectionCtx.webServer.port
275	        const lanUrl = lanCandidate === undefined
276	          ? undefined
277	          : connectionCtx.connection.authenticatedUrl(`http://${lanCandidate}:${String(port)}`)
278	        ANNOUNCED_ROOTS.add(connectionCtx.root)
279	        if (config.printUrl) {
280	          console.log(`dsh rxlab: ${authenticatedUrl}${lanUrl === undefined ? '' : ` (LAN: ${lanUrl})`}`)
281	        }
282	        if (handoffBrowser) {
283	          console.log('dsh rxlab: opening the default browser; pass --no-open to disable')
284	          void internals.openBrowser(authenticatedUrl).catch((error: unknown) => {
285	            const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
286	            console.error(`rxlab-app: could not open the default browser because ${reason}; use the dsh rxlab URL printed at startup`)
287	          })
288	        }
289	      }
290	      // This row's own activation can precede a sibling failure. The app owns
291	      // readiness by waiting for its Loader tree, or announces at once in a
292	      // hand-built tree without Loader.
293	      const settled = connectionCtx.get('loader')?.await()
294	      if (settled === undefined) announceReady()
295	      else {
296	        void settled.then(() => {
297	          // The tree can be disposed while the boot was in flight (early
298	          // SIGTERM); a URL line or browser tab for a dead server would only
299	          // mislead, and reading torn-down services would turn a clean shutdown
300	          // into a crash.
301	          if (connectionCtx.get('webServer') !== undefined
302	            && connectionCtx.get('connection') !== undefined) announceReady()
303	        // Loader reports a failed boot; this row only stays quiet.
304	        }, () => {})
305	      }
306	    })
307	  }
308	}

1	/**
2	 * @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-frontend-static — SPA dist server over the webserver
3	 * fallback seat: serves the built frontend directory with explicit index
4	 * entry points. A readable index renders at the dist root and configured index
5	 * path; missing paths return 404, traversal outside the dist root is 403,
6	 * unknown extensions ship as octet-stream, and non-GET/HEAD is 405. Every
7	 * index response first passes Connection's browser authentication, then the
8	 * webserver's index render (structured injection rows, then raw taps).
9	 * Non-index assets stay public. The dist location is workspace knowledge of
10	 * the composing application, so `distIndex` is typically supplied through a
11	 * `!!js` expression, never hardcoded by a deployment.
12	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-frontend-static
13	 */
14	
15	import type { ServerResponse } from 'node:http'
16	import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
17	import { dirname, extname, join, normalize, resolve, sep } from 'node:path'
18	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
19	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
20	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection'
21	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver'
22	
23	/** Stable Cordis plugin name. */
24	export const name = 'frontend-static'
25	
26	/** Services required before the authenticated fallback seat can be claimed. */
27	export const inject = ['webServer', 'connection']
28	
29	/** Plugin config: the dist anchor. */
30	export interface Config {
31	  /** Absolute path of index.html inside the dist root. */
32	  distIndex: string
33	}
34	
35	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
36	  distIndex: z.string().required(),
37	})
38	
39	const HTML_MIME = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
40	
41	const MIME: Record<string, string> = {
42	  '.html': HTML_MIME,
43	  '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
44	  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
45	  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
46	  '.json': 'application/json',
47	  '.map': 'application/json',
48	  '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json',
49	  // The packed VFS image. Served as its own bytes, never as a Content-Encoding:
50	  // the worker inflates the body itself, and a transport-level encoding would
51	  // leave it inflating an already-decoded archive.
52	  '.gz': 'application/gzip',
53	}
54	
55	const STATIC_MISS_CODES: ReadonlySet<string | undefined> = new Set([
56	  'ENOENT',
57	  'EISDIR',
58	  'ENOTDIR',
59	])
60	
61	/**
62	 * Serve one GET/HEAD static request from the dist root.
63	 * @param pathname - decoded URL pathname of the request.
64	 * @param res - the node:http response to write.
65	 * @param distRoot - absolute dist root directory (resolved by the caller).
66	 * @param distIndex - absolute path of index.html inside distRoot.
67	 * @param authorizeIndex - authenticates an index response before its bytes are read.
68	 * @param renderIndex - produces the index.html body (structured injection
69	 * rendering) for the dist root and configured index path.
70	 */
71	export async function serveStatic(
72	  pathname: string, res: ServerResponse, distRoot: string, distIndex: string,
73	  authorizeIndex: () => boolean,
74	  renderIndex: () => Promise<string>,
75	): Promise<void> {
76	  const target = resolve(normalize(join(distRoot, pathname)))
77	  // Traversal rejection: the target must be distRoot itself (`/`) or stay under
78	  // it. `sep`, not '/': resolve() emits backslash paths on Windows, where a '/'
79	  // suffix would reject every legitimate subpath as traversal.
80	  if (target !== distRoot && !target.startsWith(distRoot + sep)) {
81	    res.writeHead(403)
82	    res.end()
83	    return
84	  }
85	  let body: string | Buffer
86	  let type: string
87	  try {
88	    if (target === distRoot || target === distIndex) {
89	      if (!authorizeIndex()) return
90	      body = await renderIndex()
91	      type = HTML_MIME
92	    } else {
93	      body = await readFile(target)
94	      type = MIME[extname(target)] ?? 'application/octet-stream'
95	    }
96	  } catch (error) {
97	    // Only absent or non-file targets are 404; other filesystem failures reach
98	    // the webserver's request-failure handling.
99	    if (!STATIC_MISS_CODES.has((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code)) throw error
100	    res.writeHead(404)
101	    res.end()
102	    return
103	  }
104	  res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': type })
105	  res.end(body)
106	}
107	
108	/**
109	 * Claim the webserver fallback seat and serve the dist.
110	 * @param ctx - plugin context carrying the webServer service.
111	 * @param config - validated {@link Config}.
112	 */
113	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
114	  const distIndex = config.distIndex
115	  const distRoot = dirname(distIndex)
116	  // The dist is built with a relative base so the same files mount under any
117	  // static directory; served pages also answer deep SPA-fallback paths, where
118	  // relative asset URLs would resolve under the request directory, so the
119	  // served form anchors them at the site root ahead of every URL-bearing tag.
120	  const renderIndex = async (): Promise<string> => {
121	    const body = ctx.webServer.renderIndex(await readFile(distIndex, 'utf8'))
122	    return body.replace(/<head(?:\s[^>]*)?>/i, open => `${open}<base href="/">`)
123	  }
124	  ctx.effect(() => ctx.webServer.registerFallback(async (req, res) => {
125	    // Non-GET/HEAD without a matching named route is 405 (fallback-only
126	    // semantics: named routes own their method handling).
127	    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
128	      res.writeHead(405)
129	      res.end()
130	      return
131	    }
132	    /* v8 ignore next -- node:http always sets url on server requests */
133	    const rawPath = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://x').pathname
134	    await serveStatic(
135	      decodeURIComponent(rawPath),
136	      res,
137	      distRoot,
138	      distIndex,
139	      () => ctx.connection.authorizeIndex(req, res),
140	      renderIndex,
141	    )
142	  }), 'frontend-static: fallback seat')
143	}

frontend-static injects ['webServer', 'connection'] and calls ctx.connection.authorizeIndex for index requests, mints cookie on token, and renderIndex adds <base href="/"> — our SPA built with base './' + index.html includes module script src="/src/..."? Built assets hrefs relative resolved via <base href="/"> => good with BrowserRouter at '/'. Deep SPA fallback: serveStatic maps '/' only for index; unknown non-index path returns 404 (frontend-static serves real files; fallback to index for arbitrary SPA route NOT included here—unknown paths 404). That means SPA client-side routes like '/collect' direct-load → 404 (server path). BrowserRouter navigation from '/' works client side; but hard refresh at '/collect' returns 404 (no server-side history fallback). Is that acceptable? web UI currently has no URL routes (single '/' page) hence fine. Our rxlab SPA uses routes /agent etc. Direct deep-load returns 404 — degraded UX (refresh on module page). But it's client-only local GUI; acceptable? Could avoid by HashRouter (BrowserRouter w/ base). Switching SPA to HashRouter avoids server fallback need: urls like /#/agent. But we chose BrowserRouter; local host GUI with deep refresh would break to 404 page; that's a real UX problem for a workbench (user might refresh while on module). Options:
- keep BrowserRouter but ensure frontend-static serves index on unknown GET paths (SPA fallback). Modify frontend-static? shared package used by web too; changing shared behavior risky & beyond scope.
- Switch SPA to HashRouter → no server path handling issues; each module deep link becomes /#/agent. Slightly less pretty but robust; many local GUI apps use hash.

/** Model-visible orientation and acceptance boundary for sessions created through `dsh rxlab`. */
function rxlabSurfacePrompt(url: string): string {
  return `You are interacting with the user through the rxlab GUI, the DeepSeek Harness workbench browser surface at ${url}. `
    + 'When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. '
    + 'The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. '
    + 'The rxlab GUI is a standalone web application (apps/rxlab-web) served by this profile; the workbench business modules are not connected yet, '
    + 'and no agent session is created through the GUI in the current build. '
    + 'Starting another server does not update this GUI. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks.'
}

/**
 * Dist location is workspace knowledge of this bundle: anchored on the
 * frontend package manifest, not configured. Existence is a request-time
 * concern — the fallback owner reads files per request, so a composition
 * whose page never reaches the fallback seat boots without one.
 */
function resolveDistIndex(): string {
  const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
  try {
    return join(dirname(require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-web-frontend/package.json')), 'dist', 'index.html')
  } catch {
    /* v8 ignore next 2 -- reachable only when the frontend package is absent from the checkout */
    throw new Error('rxlab-app: @deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-web-frontend is not resolvable from this composition')
  }
}

import { defineConfig } from 'tsdown'
import { typertPlugin } from './packages/typert/generator/lib/types/tsdown-plugin.js'

function isBuildFaceClient(value: unknown): boolean {
  if (value === undefined || value === 'host') return false
  if (value === 'client') return true
  throw new Error(`tsdown: --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE must be host or client, received ${String(value)}`)
}

/**
 * The ordinary workspace build consumes JavaScript emitted by the Host
 * TypeScript project and runs Typert. The Client pass selects packages that
 * declare a browser bundle and lets their package-local configs emit both
 * their Node loader entry and browser artifact.
 */
export default defineConfig(({ env }) => {
  const client = isBuildFaceClient(env?.DSH_BUILD_FACE)
  return {
    workspace: ['vendor/*', 'packages/*/*', 'apps/cli'],
    entry: client ? '' : ['lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js'],
    outDir: 'lib',
    format: ['esm'],
    platform: 'node',
    target: 'es2024',
    fixedExtension: false,
    dts: false,
    clean: false,
    plugins: client ? [] : [typertPlugin({ mode: 'workspace', faces: ['host'] })],
  }
})

124	/**
125	 * Resolve one LAN-trust snapshot from the active server bind.
126	 *
127	 * Derived entries are port-less IP literals: DNS rebinding needs an
128	 * attacker-controlled name, while an IP-literal Host is safe on any port and
129	 * an OS-assigned port is unknowable before bind.
130	 * @param bindHost - the active webserver bind host.
131	 * @param extra - explicit `--trusted-host` values, in argument order.
132	 * @returns the LAN display addresses and invocation-derived fence authorities.
133	 */
134	export function resolveLanTrust(bindHost: string, extra: readonly string[]): RxlabRuntimeValues {
135	  const lanAddresses = bindHost === ALL_INTERFACES_HOST
136	    ? Object.values(networkInterfaces()).flat()
137	      .filter((iface): iface is NonNullable<typeof iface> => iface !== undefined && iface.family === 'IPv4' && !iface.internal)
138	      .map(iface => iface.address)
139	    : []
140	  return { lanAddresses, trustedHosts: [...lanAddresses, ...extra] }
141	}
