144	function rxlabSurfacePrompt(url: string): string {
145	  const updateContract = 'The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while '
146	    + '`pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. '
147	    + 'Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. '
148	  return `You are interacting with the user through the rxlab GUI, the DeepSeek Harness browser surface at ${url}. `
149	    + 'When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. '
150	    + 'The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. '
151	    + updateContract
152	    + 'Starting another server does not update this GUI. '
153	    + 'The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only a booted dsh surface such as `dsh rxlab` or `dsh web` injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. '
154	    + 'Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.'

183	  return spawn(process.execPath, [
184	    '--input-type=module',

187	  ], {

189	    stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'pipe'],

191	}

193	/** Hand one URL to the operating system's default browser. */
194	async function openBrowser(url: string): Promise<void> {
195	  const launcher = spawnBrowserLauncher(url)
196	  let launcherStderr = ''
197	  launcher.stderr?.setEncoding('utf8')
198	  launcher.stderr?.on('data', (chunk: string) => { launcherStderr += chunk })
199	  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
200	    function onError(error: Error): void {
201	      launcher.off('close', onClose)
202	      reject(error)
203	    }
204	    function onClose(code: number | null): void {
205	      launcher.off('error', onError)
206	      if (code !== 0) {
207	        const firstLine = launcherStderr.trim().split(/\r?\n/u)[0]
208	        const reason = firstLine === undefined || firstLine === ''
209	          ? `browser launcher exited with code ${String(code)}`
210	          : firstLine.replace(/^(?:[A-Za-z]*Error):\s*/u, '')
211	        reject(new Error(reason))
212	        return
213	      }
214	      if (launcherStderr !== '') process.stderr.write(launcherStderr)
215	      resolve()
216	    }
217	    launcher.once('error', onError)
218	    launcher.once('close', onClose)
219	  })
220	}

222	/** Test hooks for the built dist and native browser handoff; production never mutates them. */
223	export const internals: {
224	  resolveDistIndex: () => string
225	  openBrowser: (url: string) => Promise<void>
226	} = { resolveDistIndex, openBrowser }
227	
228	/**
229	 * Mount the rxlab runtime: dist serving, surface prompt, the bash runtime
230	 * variable, the URL line, and the default-browser handoff.
231	 * @param ctx - plugin context carrying the webServer service.
232	 * @param config - validated {@link Config}.
233	 */
234	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
235	  const runtime = resolveLanTrust(ctx.webServer.host, config.trustedHosts)
236	  // The loopback URL belongs to this host. Under SSH, the operator reaches it
237	  // through a local forwarding address that this process cannot derive.
238	  const handoffBrowser = config.openBrowser && !launchedThroughSsh(ctx)
239	  // Release dependent rows only after bind-dependent trust has been sampled once.
240	  ctx.provide(RUNTIME_SERVICE, runtime)
241	  ctx.plugin(FrontendStatic, { distIndex: internals.resolveDistIndex() })
242	  if (config.surfaceContext) {
243	    ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], (promptCtx) => {
244	      addHarnessSourceSection(promptCtx, SOURCE_ROOT)
245	      promptCtx.systemPrompt.section({
246	        name: 'app:rxlab-surface',
247	        order: promptCtx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('WEB_SURFACE'),
248	        text: () => rxlabSurfacePrompt(localRxlabUrl(promptCtx)),
249	      })
250	    })
251	    ctx.inject(['shellEnv'], (runtimeCtx) => {
252	      runtimeCtx.shellEnv.register({
253	        name: 'rxlab-runtime',
254	        variables: {
255	          [DSH_RXLAB_URL]: { description: 'Canonical local URL of the DeepSeek Harness rxlab GUI serving this session.' },
256	        },
257	        resolve: () => ({ [DSH_RXLAB_URL]: localRxlabUrl(runtimeCtx) }),
258	      })
259	    })
260	  }
261	  if (config.printUrl || handoffBrowser) {
262	    ctx.inject(['connection'], (connectionCtx) => {
263	      // The URL line and browser handoff are readiness signals: supervisors RPC
264	      // as soon as they observe the line, while a browser requests the page as
265	      // soon as it opens. Neither may run while sibling rows such as the /api
266	      // route owner are still mounting. Await Loader settlement first; a
267	      // hand-built tree without a Loader is already the complete tree.
268	      const announceReady = (): void => {
269	        if (ANNOUNCED_ROOTS.has(connectionCtx.root)) return
270	        const webUrl = localRxlabUrl(connectionCtx)
271	        const authenticatedUrl = connectionCtx.connection.authenticatedUrl(webUrl)
272	        // Reuse the exact LAN snapshot provided to the /api trust fence.
273	        const lanCandidate = runtime.lanAddresses[0]
274	        const port = connectionCtx.webServer.port
275	        const lanUrl = lanCandidate === undefined
276	          ? undefined
277	          : connectionCtx.connection.authenticatedUrl(`http://${lanCandidate}:${String(port)}`)
278	        ANNOUNCED_ROOTS.add(connectionCtx.root)
279	        if (config.printUrl) {
280	          console.log(`dsh rxlab: ${authenticatedUrl}${lanUrl === undefined ? '' : ` (LAN: ${lanUrl})`}`)
281	        }
282	        if (handoffBrowser) {
283	          console.log('dsh rxlab: opening the default browser; pass --no-open to disable')
284	          void internals.openBrowser(authenticatedUrl).catch((error: unknown) => {
285	            const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
286	            console.error(`rxlab-app: could not open the default browser because ${reason}; use the dsh rxlab URL printed at startup`)
287	          })
288	        }
289	      }
290	      // This row's own activation can precede a sibling failure. The app owns
291	      // readiness by waiting for its Loader tree, or announces at once in a
292	      // hand-built tree without Loader.
293	      const settled = connectionCtx.get('loader')?.await()
294	      if (settled === undefined) announceReady()
295	      else {
296	        void settled.then(() => {
297	          // The tree can be disposed while the boot was in flight (early
298	          // SIGTERM); a URL line or browser tab for a dead server would only
299	          // mislead, and reading torn-down services would turn a clean shutdown
300	          // into a crash.
301	          if (connectionCtx.get('webServer') !== undefined
302	            && connectionCtx.get('connection') !== undefined) announceReady()
303	        // Loader reports a failed boot; this row only stays quiet.
304	        }, () => {})
305	      }
306	    })
307	  }
308	}

2	 * @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-frontend-static — SPA dist server over the webserver
3	 * fallback seat: serves the built frontend directory with explicit index
4	 * entry points. A readable index renders at the dist root and configured index
5	 * path; missing paths return 404, traversal outside the dist root is 403,
6	 * unknown extensions ship as octet-stream, and non-GET/HEAD is 405. Every
7	 * index response first passes Connection's browser authentication, then the
8	 * webserver's index render (structured injection rows, then raw taps).
9	 * Non-index assets stay public. The dist location is workspace knowledge of
10	 * the composing application, so `distIndex` is typically supplied through a
11	 * `!!js` expression, never hardcoded by a deployment.

13	 */

15	import type { ServerResponse } from 'node:http'
16	import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

18	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
19	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
20	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection'

23	/** Stable Cordis plugin name. */
24	export const name = 'frontend-static'
25	
26	/** Services required before the authenticated fallback seat can be claimed. */
27	export const inject = ['webServer', 'connection']
28	
29	/** Plugin config: the dist anchor. */
30	export interface Config {
31	  /** Absolute path of index.html inside the dist root. */
32	  distIndex: string
33	}
34	
35	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
36	  distIndex: z.string().required(),
37	})
38	
39	const HTML_MIME = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
40	
41	const MIME: Record<string, string> = {
42	  '.html': HTML_MIME,
43	  '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
44	  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
45	  '.svg': 'image/svg+xml',
46	  '.json': 'application/json',
47	  '.map': 'application/json',
48	  '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json',
49	  // The packed VFS image. Served as its own bytes, never as a Content-Encoding:
50	  // the worker inflates the body itself, and a transport-level encoding would
51	  // leave it inflating an already-decoded archive.
52	  '.gz': 'application/gzip',
53	}
54	
55	const STATIC_MISS_CODES: ReadonlySet<string | undefined> = new Set([
56	  'ENOENT',
57	  'EISDIR',
58	  'ENOTDIR',
59	])
60	
61	/**
62	 * Serve one GET/HEAD static request from the dist root.
63	 * @param pathname - decoded URL pathname of the request.
64	 * @param res - the node:http response to write.
65	 * @param distRoot - absolute dist root directory (resolved by the caller).
66	 * @param distIndex - absolute path of index.html inside distRoot.
67	 * @param authorizeIndex - authenticates an index response before its bytes are read.
68	 * @param renderIndex - produces the index.html body (structured injection
69	 * rendering) for the dist root and configured index path.
70	 */
71	export async function serveStatic(
72	  pathname: string, res: ServerResponse, distRoot: string, distIndex: string,
73	  authorizeIndex: () => boolean,
74	  renderIndex: () => Promise<string>,
75	): Promise<void> {
76	  const target = resolve(normalize(join(distRoot, pathname)))
77	  // Traversal rejection: the target must be distRoot itself (`/`) or stay under
78	  // it. `sep`, not '/': resolve() emits backslash paths on Windows, where a '/'
79	  // suffix would reject every legitimate subpath as traversal.
80	  if (target !== distRoot && !target.startsWith(distRoot + sep)) {
81	    res.writeHead(403)
82	    res.end()
83	    return
84	  }
85	  let body: string | Buffer
86	  let type: string
87	  try {
88	    if (target === distRoot || target === distIndex) {
89	      if (!authorizeIndex()) return
90	      body = await renderIndex()
91	      type = HTML_MIME
92	    } else {
93	      body = await readFile(target)
94	      type = MIME[extname(target)] ?? 'application/octet-stream'
95	    }
96	  } catch (error) {
97	    // Only absent or non-file targets are 404; other filesystem failures reach
98	    // the webserver's request-failure handling.
99	    if (!STATIC_MISS_CODES.has((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code)) throw error
100	    res.writeHead(404)
101	    res.end()
102	    return
103	  }
104	  res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': type })
105	  res.end(body)
106	}
107	
108	/**
109	 * Claim the webserver fallback seat and serve the dist.
110	 * @param ctx - plugin context carrying the webServer service.
111	 * @param config - validated {@link Config}.
112	 */
113	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
114	  const distIndex = config.distIndex
115	  const distRoot = dirname(distIndex)
116	  // The dist is built with a relative base so the same files mount under any
117	  // static directory; served pages also answer deep SPA-fallback paths, where
118	  // relative asset URLs would resolve under the request directory, so the
119	  // served form anchors them at the site root ahead of every URL-bearing tag.
120	  const renderIndex = async (): Promise<string> => {
121	    const body = ctx.webServer.renderIndex(await readFile(distIndex, 'utf8'))
122	    return body.replace(/<head(?:\s[^>]*)?>/i, open => `${open}<base href="/">`)
123	  }
124	  ctx.effect(() => ctx.webServer.registerFallback(async (req, res) => {
125	    // Non-GET/HEAD without a matching named route is 405 (fallback-only
126	    // semantics: named routes own their method handling).
127	    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
128	      res.writeHead(405)
129	      res.end()
130	      return
131	    }
132	    /* v8 ignore next -- node:http always sets url on server requests */
133	    const rawPath = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://x').pathname
134	    await serveStatic(
135	      decodeURIComponent(rawPath),
136	      res,
137	      distRoot,
138	      distIndex,
139	      () => ctx.connection.authorizeIndex(req, res),
140	      renderIndex,
141	    )
142	  }), 'frontend-static: fallback seat')
143	}

function rxlabSurfacePrompt(url: string): string {
  return `You are interacting with the user through the rxlab GUI, the DeepSeek Harness workbench browser surface at ${url}. `
    + 'When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. '
    + 'The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. '
    + 'The rxlab GUI is a standalone web application (apps/rxlab-web) served by this profile; the workbench business modules are not connected yet, '
    + 'and no agent session is created through the GUI in the current build. '
    + 'Starting another server does not update this GUI. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks.'
}

/**
 * Dist location is workspace knowledge of this bundle: anchored on the
 * frontend package manifest, not configured. Existence is a request-time
 * concern — the fallback owner reads files per request, so a composition
 * whose page never reaches the fallback seat boots without one.
 */
function resolveDistIndex(): string {
  const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
  try {
    return join(dirname(require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-web-frontend/package.json')), 'dist', 'index.html')
  } catch {
    /* v8 ignore next 2 -- reachable only when the frontend package is absent from the checkout */
    throw new Error('rxlab-app: @deepseek-ai/dsh-rxlab-web-frontend is not resolvable from this composition')
  }
}

import { defineConfig } from 'tsdown'
import { typertPlugin } from './packages/typert/generator/lib/types/tsdown-plugin.js'

function isBuildFaceClient(value: unknown): boolean {
  if (value === undefined || value === 'host') return false
  if (value === 'client') return true
  throw new Error(`tsdown: --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE must be host or client, received ${String(value)}`)
}

/**
 * The ordinary workspace build consumes JavaScript emitted by the Host
 * TypeScript project and runs Typert. The Client pass selects packages that
 * declare a browser bundle and lets their package-local configs emit both
 * their Node loader entry and browser artifact.
 */
export default defineConfig(({ env }) => {
  const client = isBuildFaceClient(env?.DSH_BUILD_FACE)
  return {
    workspace: ['vendor/*', 'packages/*/*', 'apps/cli'],
    entry: client ? '' : ['lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js'],
    outDir: 'lib',
    format: ['esm'],
    platform: 'node',
    target: 'es2024',
    fixedExtension: false,
    dts: false,
    clean: false,
    plugins: client ? [] : [typertPlugin({ mode: 'workspace', faces: ['host'] })],
  }
})

## 先澄清「现存的逻辑」指什么

那段话描述的是**我们这几轮改出来的现状**（不是 harness 平台原本的机制）：

- rxlab 的 host 侧**依然是完整的 Cordis 树**：`dsh-base` + `rxlab-app` 的 patch 行（webserver、connection、rxlab-runtime…），模型适配器、工具注册表、会话持久化、auth、agent loop 全都在 host 的共享 Context 里，可配置替换。**这部分没有破。**
- 我们删掉的是 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的**浏览器客户端 roster 行**（`dsh.client` 的 ui-*、cordis-client-runner、modules）。原来 web UI 是「浏览器里再跑一个 Cordis Context」，UI 也是插件。rxlab 不走这条，改成独立 React 应用。
- 「经 /api 访问 host」对 agent 会话来说还是**待实现**（我们保留了 `connection` 行 = /api 网关 + cookie 认证，但 SPA 现在还没调 /api）。这条传输本身就是插件提供的现成平台面。

## 所以真正的权衡在这

「产品的每一部分都是插件」这个口号，在 harness 里精确地指 **host 平面**（能被配置层替换的服务）。rxlab 没有动摇它。被打破的是一条**不成文的客户端约定**：UI 组件曾以 Cordis client 插件形式贡献到 `window.__DSH_BOOT__` roster，由部署配置决定装哪些 UI。rxlab 现在换成「一个 App 内的模块注册表」（`src/modules/registry.tsx` + lazy Panel），模块**不再是配置可换的插件**——这正是你直觉到的那部分牺牲。

它有先例：Python SDK / TypeScript SDK 本来就是非 Cordis 消费者，通过 JSON-RPC 用 host；浏览器 UI 才是 Cordis client 的特例。rxlab 选择「产品界面 = host 的普通消费者」，是产品决策，不是架构上捅了 host 的插件模型。

## 值得警惕的裂缝（不是现在破，是未来会疼）

1. **UI 模块失去配置级可替换性**。如果哪天想「这个部署只装 Wiki 不装 效果图」，现在做不到（注册表是代码）。缓解：把 registry 做成 manifest/数据驱动（id → 懒加载路径 + 菜单项从配置来），保留一层"轻量 slot"语义，不必回到完整 Cordis client runtime。
2. **/api 契约要手维护**。host 侧已有 Typert/remotes 从 schema 生成类型化客户端（session/settings/workspace 控制器都是 host 插件）；将来写 agent 会话的 wire client 时应该消费这些生成物，而不是自己另造一套 RPC。
3. **会话里那个 Wiki 计划如果写的是「不走 Cordis 客户端栈」作为原理**，那是把我们这几轮的实现选择误当成了平台既有机制——真正的既有机制是 host 插件面 + /api 信封 + cookie 认证，这些我们原样保留。

一句话：**host 的「插件即一切」没破，破的是「UI 也作为 Cordis 客户端插件」这一层；那层是 web profile 的特定实现，rxlab 用独立 SPA + 模块注册表替代了它。** 代价是 UI 模块不如以前可配置，收益是你一开始要的独立 shadcn 工作台。

#### Thinking

The user is asking a deep architectural question. They saw in the 商品 Wiki plan (from the forked session, presumably) an explanation: "rxlab SPA 不走 Cordis 客户端栈，而是独立 React 应用经 /api 访问 host" — is that existing logic? And they're pointing out: deepseek harness, Cordis is the underlying framework of dsh: plugins contribute services to shared context, typed events, reversible side effects. Every product part is a plugin — model adapters, tool registry, session logs, agent loop itself — all replaceable by config. "现在不是打破了吗？" — isn't this now breaking that?

They're concerned: by making rxlab SPA a standalone React app (non-Cordis) that accesses host via /api, are we breaking the "everything is a plugin on Cordis" architecture principle?

I need to respond thoughtfully and accurately. Key conceptual distinctions:

1. What the "everything is a plugin" statement covers: the **host side** — every *backend* capability (model adapters, tool registry, session persistence, agent loop) is a Cordis plugin on the host, contributed into the shared Context, replaceable via composition/config (cordis.yml patch layers). Our rxlab approach does NOT change that: the host (dsh rxlab profile) is still the full Cordis tree: base plugins (agent-loop, tools, sessions, llm), plus rxlab-app bundle patch rows, etc. Removing the browser roster rows removed *client-side UI plugins* — but client UI plugins were themselves Cordis plugins *running in the browser* (a second Cordis context in the page, cordis-client-runner). The "plugin-everything" principle mostly concerns host/backend composition and extension points.

2. Cordis is a framework for *both* host and client (the browser UI itself was a Cordis context in the page: browser client plugins like ui-session/chat register slots etc.). So choosing a non-Cordis frontend does "break" that particular *client* stack convention: UI contributions were previously composable Cordis client plugins replaceable via `window.__DSH_BOOT__` roster. Now the SPA is not a Cordis client; UI modules are React modules in one app. So there IS a real trade-off the user is intuiting:
   - Pro: fully independent modern UI (shadcn), no coupling to the Cordis client runtime, faster iteration, can use any component ecosystem; UI becomes a consumer of the harness through a wire API, which matches a browser-independent client.
   - Con: UI features can no longer be swapped as config-level plugins; client UI loses the shared Cordis conventions (typed slots, effects, events) unless we reintroduce something similar in the SPA (module registry is a mini-version of that). Also the /api contract must be manually maintained rather than derived from plugin registries... Actually there is api-remotes/Typert generating typed RPC from host schemas — a standalone SPA could still consume those (they're client-side generated clients). So host capability remains plugin-based and the contract stays generated.

3. What remains intact:
   - Host composition (cordis.yml/patch layers) still defines every service: which model provider, which tools, session storage, auth cookie, webserver, etc. rxlab's minimal patch still has rows; base still there. So config-level replaceability of the *backend* is not broken.
   - Even the transport (/api gateway) is a plugin (client-connection host half). frontend-static, webserver — plugins.
   - The SPA is just another *consumer* of the harness — same as the Python SDK or a future mobile client. dsh already supports non-Cordis consumers? Actually SDKs (TypeScript/Python) consume the loop via JSON-RPC — those are non-Cordis clients of a Cordis host. So precedent exists: the product surface ≠ necessarily Cordis client. But web UI was Cordis-client; rxlab choosing standalone is a product decision, not an architecture violation of host plugin model.

4. Risks / what we should watch:
   - If later we want rxlab UI modules to be independently replaceable/configurable (like plugins), we need a module system: current registry is code-level; could evolve to config/manifest-driven lazy modules. That's a *deliberate replacement* of the client-plugin mechanism, with trade-offs.
   - The /api surface a standalone SPA uses must be stable & typed; there's the existing envelope + Typert remotes for session/workspace/settings controllers (already present as host plugins). We kept `connection` row exactly so /api remains. The wire client for the agent chat can be written once as a typed module.
   - Model-visible ⇔ logged rule, approvals, etc. remain on host; UI merely renders.

So answer: No — not breaking the framework-level principle, because plugin-everything governs the host/Cordis context; rxlab host is still fully Cordis (base + bundle patch). What we did remove is the *browser Cordis client runtime* — that's a UI delivery mechanism, not the product's plugin backbone. We should be precise: the statement "dsh's every part is a plugin replaceable by config" is true for the host plane and remains true; UI composition in rxlab is now an app-level module registry instead of client plugins — a conscious trade-off (user already chose standalone+shadcn). And it matches existing precedent (SDK consumers aren't Cordis clients). Also mention where the gap bites & mitigation (module manifest could later be made dynamic; /api typed clients via existing Typert remotes; keep host rows minimal but extensible).

If the plan (from forked session) claims "不走 Cordis 客户端栈" as "现存的逻辑" — it's describing our implemented current state (the last commits), i.e., 现存事实 yes. Clarify "现存逻辑" two senses: (a) current code does this (yes we implemented), (b) pre-existing platform mechanism — no, it's new; but the /api+envelope transport is pre-existing (client-connection). Also "经 /api 访问 host" is future-facing for agent chat: currently SPA calls no /api; the /api gateway & cookie are there (connection row) — that's existing platform surface. So answer with nuance.

Also acknowledge genuine trade-offs & propose how to keep "plugin/spirit" inside the SPA: module registry akin to slots; host stays source of truth; possibly UI config manifest so modules remain declarative/replaceable per deployment (without Cordis client runtime). We could keep a thin typed bridge generated from host schemas (Typert/remotes client packages) rather than hand RPC.

Keep answer structured but concise, in Chinese, referencing concrete code: host plugin tree unchanged (base + rxlab-app patch rows in cordis.patch.yml), browser roster removal only removed dsh.client rows; frontend-static/webserver/connection still plugins; SDK precedent; module registry as lightweight equivalent; caution: future UI-module-as-config needs design (could reintroduce manifest-driven registry, not full Cordis client).

行照常组合，`webserver`、`connection`（/api 网关 + 浏览器 cookie 认证）、`frontend-static`（SPA fallback 席位）本身也都是插件。\n\n被删掉的是 **浏览器客户端 roster**（`cordis.patch.yml` 里 `dsh.client` 的 ui-*、cordis-client-runner、modules host」对 rxlab 的 agent 会话目前是**规划中**而非已完成：SPA 现阶段不调 /api，但 `connection` 行已保留 /api 网关与 cookie 认证，是现成的平台面。\n\n## 没有破的部分\n\n- host 插件树不变：base 的 agent-loop/工具/会话等与 rxlab-app 新增行全部按原机制组合、可配置替换。\n- 传输面由插件提供：webserver 路由、frontend-static fallback、connection 的 /api 信封 + 浏览器认证都是 host 插件；未来加会话通道不需要改框架。\n- 有先例：TypeScript / Python SDK 本来就是非 Cordis 消费者，通过 JSON-RPC 使用 host；「产品界面 = host 的普通消费者」不是新发明。\n- web profile 完全不受影响，仍是 Cordis 客户端栈的参考实现。\n\n## 破掉的约定与代价\n\n- UI 模块失去配置级可替换性：原来 roster 决定装哪些 UI 插件，现在注册表是代码（id → lazy Panel），部署无法只靠配置裁剪模块。\n- UI 与 host 之间不再共享 Cordis 客户端的类型化事件/副作用生命周期，事件渲染、状态同步要由 SPA 自己接（会话接入时是主要工作量）。\n- /api 契约需要维护：若不消费 host 侧已有的 Typert/remotes 生成客户端（session/settings/workspace 控制器），而自造一套 RPC，会造成双份协议。\n\n## 缓解与后续\n\n- 把模块注册表演进为 manifest/数据驱动（菜单项与懒加载路径来自配置或构建清单），保留\"轻量 slot + 部署可裁剪\"语义，不必回到完整 Cordis 客户端 runtime。\n- agent 会话的 wire client 优先复用 Typert/remotes 生成的类型化客户端与现有 /api 信封，不自造协议。\n- 会话控制器等 host 行当前从 rxlab patch 移除了（保持最小面），会话模块接入时按需加回对应行（它们都还存在于 deepseek-harness 平台的既有机制。\n",

}
